verdict.summary: The pagination fixes are correct and complete as scoped. Capped `gh pr list` call sites now fail closed on saturation, while issue-deduplication call sites use the REST issues endpoint with `--paginate --slurp`, correctly flatten page arrays and exclude pull requests. The focused tests exercise the production call sites, include below-cap/absent-marker negative controls, and model both the old truncated and new paginated CLI response shapes, so they are not vacuous. No correctness, soundness, or security defect was found. Local execution of two focused unittest modules was unavailable because PyYAML is not installed in the review environment; the batch-merge self-test did execute successfully.
